Man Dies After Alleged Assault in Delhi Metro Over Seat

A 48-year-old man died in Delhi after an alleged assault inside a Metro train. The incident reportedly occurred in front of his mother and was related to a dispute over a seat. Police have arrested a former IAS officer and his son in connection with the death. The former officer is accused of corruption.
